name: World-aligned lattice octree bake
definition: Creates a hierarchical level-of-detail (HLOD) octree for Gaussian splats aligned to world axes, grouping splats into leaves with bounded counts and ordering them by importance to enable efficient streaming and culling.
summary: World-aligned lattice octree bake pre-computes a spatial hierarchy of Gaussian splats to optimize memory access and prevent false resident culls, differing from standard splatting by relying on pre-computed bounds rather than runtime sorting.
